Title: [LSJ] Flesh of Marble, Carrion Crows and Disarm

Messages.Author: JH
Messages.Body:
I attack with a vampire with ANI POT FOR against a vampire with PRO.
Before range I play Carrion Crows and he play Flesh of Marble. Both
strike hands for 1. In the strike resolution I prevent his hand strike
for 1.

Can he choose to suffer 1 damage from Carrion Crows and prevent my
hand strike with Flesh of Marble thus preventing me from playing Disarm?

Or do I as an acting minion choose which damage effect resolves first?

What if my vampire was blocking minion?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
JH wrote:
> I attack with a vampire with ANI POT FOR against a vampire with PRO.
> Before range I play Carrion Crows and he play Flesh of Marble. Both
> strike hands for 1. In the strike resolution I prevent his hand strike
> for 1.
>
> Can he choose to suffer 1 damage from Carrion Crows and prevent my
> hand strike with Flesh of Marble thus preventing me from playing Disarm?

Yes.

> Or do I as an acting minion choose which damage effect resolves first?

No. The effects resolve simultaneously.

> What if my vampire was blocking minion?

Same.

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
> I attack with a vampire with ANI POT FOR against a vampire with PRO.
> Before range I play Carrion Crows and he play Flesh of Marble. Both
> strike hands for 1. In the strike resolution I prevent his hand strike
> for 1.
>
> Can he choose to suffer 1 damage from Carrion Crows and prevent my
> hand strike with Flesh of Marble thus preventing me from playing Disarm?
>

Yes.

> Or do I as an acting minion choose which damage effect resolves first?
>

They resolve simultaneously. Strike Resolution is the *only* time things
resolve simultaneously.

> What if my vampire was blocking minion?
>

Same. The Blocking Minion's strike, the Acting Minion's strike, and all
"during strike resolution" environmental effects resolve simultaneously.

-Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
